title: M5Unified rtc_sync writes UTC so RTC time does not drift on reboot

execution.environment: macOS arm64 + uiflow-idf:v5.5.4; StopWatch bench node

checks.name: baseline_hardware_repro
checks.evidence: RTC hour changed from 0x11 UTC to 0x20 local (UTC+9) after M5.begin()

checks.name: fixed_hardware_behavior

checks.name: firmware_build

checks.name: restore_stock_image

checks.name: stamplc_device_repro
